plates.note: Multi-date mosaic: AOI spans UTM zones 50/51 and two relative orbits, so no single date covers it. West 50QRE/50QRD @ 2024-02-19 (cloud ~0%), east 51QTU/QTV/QUU/QUV @ 2023-03-23 (max cloud 2.6%). Per-tile gain matching applied to soften the date seam (still faintly visible). Some clouds in SW corner (50QRD). Coverage 99.97%.
